name: Gluvo-nemo

narrator.name: The Atlas narrator
narrator.voice: warm, unhurried, curious; a documentary voice that never oversells; speaks the dance's own words (names, counts) clearly
narrator.rule: The narrator only says what the profile says. Every sentence can be traced to a section, a claim or the music/movement DNA.
narrator.identity: one narrator for the whole atlas: the same face and animation everywhere; a native-speaker voice of the same character per language (studio-grade); the viewer chooses the language
narrator.wardrobe: in each episode the narrator wears the traditional apparel associated with the dance, reconstructed with meticulous care from the profile's costume notes and the licensed images — genuine and respectful, never a caricature; sacred, ceremonial or restricted attire is never worn (the narrator stays in neutral dress with a respectful nod in colour and fabric); the pack's visual_brief.wardrobe says which
narrator.languages: master narration in English; translations per language in episodes/i18n/<lang>/<slug>.json with the same scene structure (pipeline/translate.py); names, places and counts are never translated

instructor.persona: A village elder from Galičnik who emphasizes listening with the body.
instructor.rule: counts out loud; demonstrates front and back; three slow repetitions before tempo; one correction at a time

scenes.title: Cold open
narration: The Sound of Silence
This is Gluvo-nemo. Traditional.
on_screen: Hero video — MISSING
Title card: Gluvo-nemo · North Macedonia · Traditional

scenes.title: Where and when
narration: The dance originates from the Small Reka and Galičnik regions of North Macedonia, specifically along the Radika river.
It is a traditional oro of the Mijak ethnographic group.
on_screen: Map: North Macedonia · Europe
Image — MISSING

scenes.title: When it is danced
narration: Gluvo-nemo is a display of rhythmic synchronization and communal identity among women in the Radika river region.
Today it is a living tradition.
on_screen: Footage — MISSING (use images)

scenes.title: Watch it
narration: Dancers form a half-circle.
They hold the belts of adjacent dancers, with the left arm crossed over the right.
The dance follows a 2/4 rhythm, marked by the movement of the body rather than external music.
Watch for Belt-hold chain.
on_screen: Hero video — MISSING
Captions name each signature move as it appears
scenes.music: diegetic (the video's own sound), underscore under narration

scenes.title: Listen
narration: No musical instruments are used.
The rhythm is provided solely by the clinking of coins on the chests of the women's costumes.
Listen for the Silver coins (costume element).
The pulse is 2/4.
The sound is characterized by the absence of melody or drums, replaced by the sharp, metallic clinking of silver coins striking each other in a 2/4 meter.
on_screen: Instrument names on screen as each is mentioned
Verified recording — MISSING

scenes.title: Welcome
narration: Chapter 1 — First steps. Today: Master the belt-hold.
Level: 1. Difficulty of the dance overall: intermediate.

on_screen: Instructor front view, name of the chapter, the three things you will learn

scenes.title: Body and posture
narration: Upright and disciplined
Holding belts with the left arm over the right arm
Steady, providing the impulse to shake the chest coins

scenes.title: Count and rhythm

Clap it first, then step it in place.

scenes.title: Step A — slowly
narration: Step 1: Form a half-circle with other dancers
Step 2: Reach for the belts of neighbors, crossing left arm over the right

Drill: Practice crossing the left arm over the right to find the neighbor's belt
on_screen: Instructor front view, then back view (student's perspective); repetitions per step: about 4
Counts on screen
scenes.counts: 1-2, 1-2 (two beats a bar; practice pulse only)

scenes.title: Step B — the next layer
narration: Step 3: Listen for the collective rhythm of the chest coins
Step 4: Step in a 2/4 meter, ensuring the coins strike on the beat
Drill: Maintain a consistent distance in the half-circle
on_screen: Instructor front and back view; slow, then half tempo
scenes.counts: 1-2, 1-2 (two beats a bar; practice pulse only)

scenes.title: Put it together
narration: Step A, then Step B, without stopping. Slow first.
Now half tempo. Now full tempo.

on_screen: Split screen: front view / back view
